probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Ingrid Solberg © Work Courses Products Journal About Overview [email protected] Contact Menu Close 01 Work 02 Courses 03 Products 04 Journal 05 About 06 Overview 07 Contact [email protected] (Brand identity) Identity for a stoneware studio A quiet mark and a warm palette for a two-person pottery that sells from its own shop floor. Client A stoneware studio Location Bergen, Norway Year 2026 Services Identity, Print, Packaging (Overview) The brief The studio had grown from a garage kiln into a shop with a waiting list, but its look was still a borrowed script font and a phone photo. The owners wanted something as calm as the pots, and nothing that would date in five years. The work The mark is a circle cut by a single line: the wheel and the wire used to lift a pot from it. It is debossed rather than printed wherever possible, so it reads as a texture before it reads as a logo. The palette comes straight from the clay body, with terracotta for wrapping and a charcoal for type. The result Everything the studio prints now fits on two paper stocks and one stamp. The owners wrap orders themselves in under a minute, and the shop has not needed a new sign since it opened. (
